contract_plain_english: In the two-sided Hoeffding setting, let X_1,...,X_N be independent symmetric Bernoulli random variables, let a = (a_1,...,a_N) be in R^N, define S = sum_{i=1}^N a_i X_i, and take t > 0. Then the two-sided event {|S| >= t} splits into the two disjoint non-strict tail events {S >= t} and {-S >= t}, so its probability is exactly P{S >= t} + P{-S >= t}. The paragraph itself omits the t > 0 quantifier, but the immediately following two-sided theorem states it [PDF p. 6 / printed p. 17, paragraph and Theorem 2.2.5].
